developmentCases.commonActorContext: Create isolated Java target 21 fixture using cached Reactor 3.6.9 and reactive-streams 1.0.4. Pipeline: Mono.fromCallable(client::call).subscribeOn(ioWorkers).publishOn(loop).map(storage::loadPayload).map(consumer::accept). ioWorkers=Schedulers.newBoundedElastic(1,8,"io-workers"); loop=Schedulers.newSingle("test-loop"). Client.call performs synchronous I/O and returns a key. Consumer.accept requires loop thread. FileStorage.loadPayload calls Files.readString on a temporary fixture file (wrap IOException as UncheckedIOException); MemoryStorage uses a small immutable Map.of(...).get with no disk fallback. Current test checks only client.call execution thread. Dispose schedulers and isolate fixture files.
